name: Mercury

temperature.description: Extreme temperature changes between day and night.

habitability.assessment: No known life. Mercury has almost no atmosphere and extreme temperatures.
habitability.liquid_water: No stable liquid water on the surface. Water ice may exist in permanently shadowed polar craters.

water: Water ice may exist in permanently shadowed polar craters.
interesting_facts: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
It is the smallest planet in the solar system.
A year on Mercury lasts only 88 Earth days.
Despite being closest to the Sun, it is not the hottest planet.

name: Venus

temperature.description: The hottest planetary surface in the solar system.

habitability.assessment: No known life. Extreme heat, pressure, and atmospheric chemistry make the surface extremely hostile.
habitability.liquid_water: No stable liquid water on the surface.

surface: Volcanic plains, mountains, and impact craters.
water: Very little water vapor in the atmosphere and no known surface oceans.
interesting_facts: Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system.
Its atmosphere is mostly carbon dioxide.
Its thick atmosphere creates an extreme greenhouse effect.
Venus rotates in the opposite direction to most planets.

name: Earth

habitability.assessment: The only known planet with life. It has liquid water, a protective atmosphere, and suitable environmental conditions.
habitability.liquid_water: Abundant liquid water on the surface.

surface: Oceans, continents, mountains, deserts, and polar ice.
water: Liquid water covers approximately 71% of Earth's surface.
interesting_facts: Earth is the only known world with life.
It is the fifth-largest planet in the solar system.
Its atmosphere protects life from much harmful radiation.
Earth has one natural moon.

name: Mars

temperature.description: Cold desert environment with large temperature variations.

habitability.human_habitability: Not currently habitable without life-support systems
habitability.assessment: No confirmed life has been discovered. Scientists investigate whether ancient microbial life may once have existed.
habitability.liquid_water: Water ice exists. Liquid water is not stable on most of the surface under present conditions.

surface: Red rocky deserts, volcanoes, valleys, and ancient river channels.
water: Water ice exists beneath the surface and near the polar regions.
interesting_facts: Mars is known as the Red Planet.
It has the largest volcano in the solar system, Olympus Mons.
A day on Mars is slightly longer than an Earth day.
Scientists search for signs of ancient microbial life on Mars.

name: Jupiter

temperature.description: Approximate temperature at the 1-bar atmospheric pressure level.

habitability.assessment: No known life. Jupiter has no solid surface and has extreme atmospheric conditions.
habitability.liquid_water: Water exists in its atmosphere, but no confirmed surface oceans.

surface: No solid surface. Its atmosphere gradually becomes denser with depth.
water: Water vapor and clouds exist in the atmosphere. Europa, one of its moons, has a subsurface ocean.
interesting_facts: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
Its Great Red Spot is a giant long-lasting storm.
Ganymede, one of its moons, is larger than Mercury.
Europa is considered an important target in the search for environments that could support life.

name: Saturn

temperature.description: Approximate temperature at the 1-bar atmospheric pressure level.

habitability.assessment: No known life on Saturn. Some of its moons are interesting places to investigate for conditions that might support life.
habitability.liquid_water: No known surface oceans on Saturn. Its moon Enceladus has a subsurface ocean.

surface: No solid surface. Saturn is mostly hydrogen and helium.
water: Its moon Enceladus has a global subsurface ocean. Titan has lakes and seas of liquid methane and ethane.
interesting_facts: Saturn is famous for its spectacular ring system.
It is less dense than water on average.
Titan has lakes and rivers of liquid hydrocarbons.
Enceladus releases water-rich plumes into space.

name: Uranus

habitability.assessment: No known life. Uranus has no accessible solid surface and has an extremely cold atmosphere.
habitability.liquid_water: No known surface liquid water. Water is thought to exist deep inside the planet in exotic high-pressure conditions.

surface: No solid surface. The planet is composed mainly of hot dense fluids beneath its atmosphere.
water: Water is believed to exist deep inside the planet as part of its icy interior.
interesting_facts: Uranus rotates almost on its side.
It has a faint ring system.
Methane in its atmosphere gives it a blue-green appearance.
It experiences extreme seasonal changes.

name: Neptune

temperature.description: Approximate temperature in the upper atmosphere.

habitability.assessment: No known life. Neptune is extremely cold and has no accessible solid surface.
habitability.liquid_water: No known surface liquid water. Water is believed to exist deep inside the planet.

surface: No solid surface. Neptune has a deep atmosphere above a dense interior.
water: Water is thought to exist deep inside Neptune, mixed with other materials.
interesting_facts: Neptune is the farthest recognized planet from the Sun.
It has some of the fastest winds in the solar system.
Triton, its largest moon, orbits in the opposite direction to Neptune's rotation.
One year on Neptune lasts about 165 Earth years.
